_comment: Help > What's New in Loupe, and once after each update. One entry per release version (X.Y.Z, betas share it): a few highlights, each a ToolIcon glyph, a short title and one line. The dialog lists this release and the ones before it, marking those since the version the user updated from. A test fails if the project version has no entry.

items.title: Opens faster
items.body: Big assemblies open in about a third less time, and repeated parts load once.

items.title: Measure by snapping
items.body: See what a click takes, from corners and hole centres to the axes of round features. Pinned results can be dragged and coloured.

items.title: Sections you aim
items.body: Cut along a face or through a hole's axis. Cut parts show solid, with their holes open.

items.title: Exploded views that explain
items.body: Save layouts, turn parts about a snapped pivot, and follow dashed lines back to where each part goes.

items.title: Every copy counts
items.body: Each copy of a repeated sub-assembly shows and exports on its own.

items.title: Touch, and select all
items.body: On a touchscreen, one finger orbits and two pan and zoom. Cmd/Ctrl+A selects every part.

items.title: Tabs and windows
items.body: Open several files at once. Drag a tab to reorder it, into a window of its own, or onto another Loupe window.

items.title: Exploded view
items.body: Pull an assembly apart with handles, switch between Assembled and Exploded, and export the layout.

items.title: Saved views
items.body: Save what is hidden or transparent, or where the camera is, and come back to it in one click.

items.title: Updates in the app
items.body: New versions appear in the toolbar and install in place, keeping your settings.

items.title: Transparency you control
items.body: Set each part's opacity and outline, and see what is hidden or transparent in the assembly tree.

items.title: Faster, and measured
items.body: Large assemblies section far sooner, and Document properties shows how long each file took to open.

items.title: A refined interface
items.body: A light and dark switch, drawn icons, matching panels, and part colours that tell neighbours apart.
